title: Module 4 Quiz: Buying & Selling Crypto Safely

questions.text: Which of the following is a key indicator of a reputable cryptocurrency exchange?
options: Publishes regular Proof of Reserves audits
questions.explanation: Reputable exchanges publish Proof of Reserves to prove they hold customer assets.

questions.text: What is the main risk associated with placing a market order?
options: It may never execute if price not reached
It incurs higher deposit fees than limit orders
It may execute at a price different from the quoted price due to slippage
It requires setting a maximum price
questions.explanation: Market orders prioritize speed and can suffer slippage, executing at a different price than quoted.

questions.text: True or false: Calculating total transaction cost percentage before confirming a trade is unnecessary.
questions.explanation: Calculating total cost helps avoid hidden fees.

questions.text: True or false: Before depositing funds, you should verify that the exchange supports withdrawals to your local bank account.
questions.explanation: Verifying supported local payout methods prevents funds from being trapped.
